title: Whole Turkey (frozen)

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes in the target week. Recent weeks show no sustained trend beyond noise (ordinary week noise: 122%). The baseline already reflects seasonal patterns (back-to-school in Aug) and holiday effects (Labor Day). The 2026-09-28 spike (11 units) is isolated and not explained by a known driver. Past promotions show high variance and noise-adjusted effects near 1.0. Classical uplift model confirms no expected lift. No evidence supports a deviation from baseline. Confidence is high due to stable price, no known drivers, and consistent historical noise.
